verdict.rationale: The pack contains no published benchmarks or measured latency or throughput figures for WezTerm. The only performance-related material is the 'GPU-accelerated' tagline and qualitative community anecdotes, some saying it feels faster and some saying it has higher latency, with no numbers attached. Benchmark transparency is a fair question for a terminal emulator, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/throughput numbers backing the terminal's performance claims
